summary:
The Celsius-to-Fahrenheit app is written on `desk:apps:temp` and works: I tested it in the running app (-35.5 gives F: -31.9, Backspace trims the text, letters are ignored, 77 gives 170.6), then closed it with Ctrl+Q.

I used a record state `{t: ''}`, with the digit check written as `find('0123456789-.', k) > 0`. The app reads and changes no pages, and I added no extra pages.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app "Celsius to Fahrenheit"
task start()
give {t: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
set t to s.t
when find('0123456789-.', k) > 0
set t to t & k
done
when k is 'backspace'
when count(t) > 0
set t to slice(t, 1, count(t) - 1)
done
done
give {t: t}
done
task draw(s)
set f to '?'
when count(s.t) > 0
when is_number(s.t)
set f to text((number(s.t) * 9) / 5 + 32)
done
done
show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s.t)
show(2, 1, 'F: ' & f)
done
